name: Myanmar
value: Sagaing strike kills 11 (7 Nov); Sittwe fighting
summary: A military gyrocopter strike killed 11 in a Sagaing village on 7 Nov; Rakhine airstrikes and Sittwe fighting continue
state: RFA reported on 10 Nov that a military gyrocopter bombing of a school area in Kani township, Sagaing, killed 11 people including four children, around 7 Nov. Military airstrikes on Rakhine townships killed at least 15 civilians on 1 Nov (Anadolu), and fighting with the Arakan Army continues around Sittwe. The Myanmar Internet Project counted 581 airstrikes killing at least 353 civilians from July to September. No major city has changed hands, so the status stays at Watch.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to much of Myanmar. Communications blackouts across many townships make news from affected areas slow and hard to verify.
rubric_hit: Watch: civil war at sustained intensity; no major city fallen or new mass-casualty strike found (Alert line)

sources.title: RFA — No internet, no advance warning: 11 killed in Myanmar military bombing in Sagaing
Anadolu — Myanmar military airstrikes kill at least 15 civilians, including 12 in Rakhine State

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.

rubric.alert: Major city falls, mass-casualty airstrikes, or cross-border escalation.
